full_prompt_en: A spontaneous 35 mm color-film snapshot looks upward from a narrow city street. Dark old building facades press in from left and right, leaving a tall irregular opening of saturated cyan-blue sky. A bright midday sun peeks from the left building edge and partially disappears into a glowing white cloud near the center. Strong rainbow flare arcs across the frame twice: a wide prismatic band enters from the upper left, and a smaller band crosses the building on the lower right. The optical artifacts are conspicuous but organic, seeming to belong to a real handheld camera facing directly into the light. The left facade is nearly black-green, with only faint windows and stone texture visible; the right is warmer brown with a few readable openings. Clouds remain luminous and slightly blown out, while the blue sky retains deep color. The viewpoint is tilted and imperfectly centered, allowing building edges to form steep diagonals and the sun to fall off axis. Film grain, mild softness, and a hint of vignette keep the surfaces from looking clinically clean. Color is punchy but not uniformly bright: turquoise sky, white cloud, dark olive shadow, rusty stone, and spectral red-yellow-green flare have distinct areas. The high contrast and light leakage make an ordinary street glance feel immediate, playful, and serendipitous, like a single unrepeatable exposure caught while walking.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅自发的35毫米彩色胶片快照从狭窄城市街道向上望。两侧旧楼深色立面向内压来，留下高而不规则的饱和青蓝天空开口。明亮正午太阳从左侧楼边探出，部分消失在中央发光白云里。强烈彩虹耀斑两次划过画框：宽光谱带从左上进入，较小的一条穿过右下建筑。光学痕迹显眼却有机，像真实手持相机迎光拍摄时自然留下。左立面近黑绿，只能隐约见窗和石纹；右侧较暖棕，少数开口可辨。云亮而略过曝，蓝天则保留深颜色。视角倾斜且并非完美居中，让楼边成为陡斜线，太阳偏离轴线。胶片颗粒、轻柔解析和一点暗角让表面不显临床般干净。颜色有力却不处处明亮：青绿天空、白云、暗橄榄影、锈色石材与红黄绿光谱各有清楚区域。高反差与漏光让普通街头一瞥变得即时、俏皮且偶然，像步行中抓到一次不可重复的曝光。
style_prompt_en: Spontaneous color-film photography gives saturated cyan and turquoise broad area against deep green-black shadows and warm brown fragments. A direct bright source blooms toward white and creates prismatic arcs, small colored reflections, and imperfect lens artifacts. The contrast is strong, with shadow detail partly compressed, while grain, slight softness, and subtle vignette keep the image tactile. A tilted upward viewpoint makes dark cropped masses frame an irregular bright opening; edges converge in lively diagonals rather than orderly symmetry. Bright vaporous forms and hard structural silhouettes alternate across the field. Optical flare cuts across both dark and light surfaces, adding a second curved rhythm to the angular composition. The color is vivid but uneven, with concentrated spectral accents rather than a uniform filter. The finish feels handheld, accidental, and sunstruck, preserving the quirks of a real exposure.
style_prompt_zh: 自发彩色胶片摄影让饱和青蓝与绿松石色占宽阔区域，对比深绿黑阴影和暖棕碎片。直接强光向白色泛开，产生光谱弧、小彩色反光和不完美镜头痕迹。反差强，阴影细节部分压缩，而颗粒、轻微柔度和细微暗角保持触感。倾斜仰视使深色截切体量框住不规则明亮开口；边缘汇成活泼斜线，而非整齐对称。明亮汽化形与硬结构剪影在场中交替。镜头耀斑穿过暗面和亮面，为角度分明的构图添加第二道曲线节奏。颜色鲜明却不均匀，光谱强调集中而非统一滤镜。饰面像手持拍摄、偶然又迎光，保留真实曝光的怪趣。
theme_en: An upward street view catches midday sun, blue sky, and rainbow lens flare between old buildings
theme_zh: 仰望旧楼之间的街道，正午阳光、蓝天和彩虹镜头光斑同时出现
name: Lomography Color 100
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
